from itertools import permutations

def rank_of_number(N):
    digits = list(str(N))
    unique_permutations = set(permutations(digits))
    sorted_permutations = sorted([''.join(p) for p in unique_permutations])
    rank = sorted_permutations.index(str(N)) + 1
    return rank

def main():

        print(result)
